en.g: Describe actions in progress at a moment in the past.
p: Form: was or were plus verb-ing: I was walking, they were talking.
Use it for a scene at a specific time: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Negative and question: I wasn't sleeping. What were you doing?
en.q: What were you doing yesterday at seven in the evening?
en.c: Write what five people in your life were doing at noon yesterday, with the past continuous.

de.g: Du beschreibst Handlungen, die in der Vergangenheit gerade abliefen.
p: Form: was oder were plus Verb-ing: I was walking, they were talking.
Für eine Szene zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Verneinung und Frage: I wasn't sleeping. What were you doing?
de.q: Was hast du gestern um sieben Uhr abends gerade gemacht?
de.c: Schreib, was fünf Menschen in deinem Leben gestern um zwölf gerade machten, im past continuous.

es.g: Describe acciones en curso en un momento del pasado.
p: Forma: was o were más verbo-ing: I was walking, they were talking.
Sirve para una escena en un momento concreto: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Negativa y pregunta: I wasn't sleeping. What were you doing?
es.q: ¿Qué estabas haciendo ayer a las siete de la tarde?
es.c: Escribe qué estaban haciendo cinco personas de tu vida ayer a mediodía, con el past continuous.

fr.g: Décrire des actions en cours à un moment du passé.
p: Forme : was ou were plus verbe-ing : I was walking, they were talking.
Pour une scène à un moment précis : At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Négation et question : I wasn't sleeping. What were you doing?
fr.q: Que faisais-tu hier à sept heures du soir ?
fr.c: Écris ce que cinq personnes de ta vie faisaient hier à midi, avec le past continuous.

it.g: Descrivi azioni in corso in un momento del passato.
p: Forma: was o were più verbo-ing: I was walking, they were talking.
Serve per una scena in un momento preciso: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Negativa e domanda: I wasn't sleeping. What were you doing?
it.q: Cosa stavi facendo ieri alle sette di sera?
it.c: Scrivi cosa stavano facendo cinque persone della tua vita ieri a mezzogiorno, con il past continuous.

pt.g: Descreve ações em curso num momento do passado.
p: Forma: was ou were mais verbo-ing: I was walking, they were talking.
Serve para uma cena num momento exato: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Negativa e pergunta: I wasn't sleeping. What were you doing?
pt.q: O que estavas a fazer ontem às sete da tarde?
pt.c: Escreve o que cinco pessoas da tua vida estavam a fazer ontem ao meio-dia, com o past continuous.

pt_BR.g: Descreva ações em andamento num momento do passado.
p: Forma: was ou were mais verbo-ing: I was walking, they were talking.
Serve para uma cena num momento exato: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Negativa e pergunta: I wasn't sleeping. What were you doing?
pt_BR.q: O que você estava fazendo ontem às sete da noite?
pt_BR.c: Escreva o que cinco pessoas da sua vida estavam fazendo ontem ao meio-dia, com o past continuous.

vocab.ex: I was walking in the park at nine.
They were talking about the match.
At eight, we were having dinner.
I wasn't sleeping, I was reading.
What were you doing last night at ten?
At that moment, it was raining.

target.gram: Past continuous: was/were + verb-ing for an action in progress at a past moment: At six I was cooking.

en.g: Combine a long background action with a short one that interrupts it.
p: Past continuous is the long action: I was cooking...
Past simple is the short action that happens in the middle: ...when you called.
Finished actions in a row all use the past simple: I got up, had a shower and left.
en.q: What were you doing when you heard some good news recently?
en.c: Write three sentences with the pattern I was ...-ing when ... happened.

de.g: Du verbindest eine lange Hintergrundhandlung mit einer kurzen Unterbrechung.
p: Das past continuous ist die lange Handlung: I was cooking...
Das past simple ist die kurze Handlung mittendrin: ...when you called.
Abgeschlossene Handlungen nacheinander stehen alle im past simple: I got up, had a shower and left.
de.q: Was hast du gerade gemacht, als du zuletzt eine gute Nachricht bekommen hast?
de.c: Schreib drei Sätze nach dem Muster I was ...-ing when ... happened.

es.g: Combina una acción larga de fondo con otra corta que la interrumpe.
p: El past continuous es la acción larga: I was cooking...
El past simple es la acción corta que ocurre en medio: ...when you called.
Varias acciones terminadas seguidas van todas en past simple: I got up, had a shower and left.
es.q: ¿Qué estabas haciendo cuando recibiste una buena noticia hace poco?
es.c: Escribe tres frases con el modelo I was ...-ing when ... happened.

fr.g: Combiner une longue action de fond et une action courte qui l'interrompt.
p: Le past continuous, c'est l'action longue : I was cooking...
Le past simple, c'est l'action courte au milieu : ...when you called.
Des actions terminées à la suite prennent toutes le past simple : I got up, had a shower and left.
fr.q: Que faisais-tu quand tu as appris une bonne nouvelle récemment ?
fr.c: Écris trois phrases sur le modèle I was ...-ing when ... happened.

it.g: Unisci un'azione lunga di sfondo a una breve che la interrompe.
p: Il past continuous è l'azione lunga: I was cooking...
Il past simple è l'azione breve che arriva nel mezzo: ...when you called.
Azioni concluse una dopo l'altra vanno tutte al past simple: I got up, had a shower and left.
it.q: Cosa stavi facendo quando hai ricevuto una bella notizia di recente?
it.c: Scrivi tre frasi con lo schema I was ...-ing when ... happened.

pt.g: Junta uma ação longa de fundo com outra curta que a interrompe.
p: O past continuous é a ação longa: I was cooking...
O past simple é a ação curta que acontece no meio: ...when you called.
Ações terminadas seguidas vão todas para o past simple: I got up, had a shower and left.
pt.q: O que estavas a fazer quando recebeste uma boa notícia há pouco tempo?
pt.c: Escreve três frases com o modelo I was ...-ing when ... happened.

pt_BR.g: Junte uma ação longa de fundo com outra curta que a interrompe.
p: O past continuous é a ação longa: I was cooking...
O past simple é a ação curta que acontece no meio: ...when you called.
Ações terminadas em sequência ficam todas no past simple: I got up, had a shower and left.
pt_BR.q: O que você estava fazendo quando recebeu uma boa notícia há pouco tempo?
pt_BR.c: Escreva três frases com o modelo I was ...-ing when ... happened.

vocab.ex: I was cooking when the phone rang.
She called while I was working.
The doorbell rang during the film.
I was driving home when I saw her.
They arrived when we were eating.
I closed the book, then I went to bed.

target.gram: Long action in past continuous + short interrupting action in past simple: I was reading when the lights went out.

en.g: Link past actions with when and while to set the scene.
p: While usually goes with the long action: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When usually goes with the short action: I was walking home when it started to rain.
You can start with either part; add a comma when the linking word comes first.
en.q: Finish my sentence: While I was waiting for the bus...
en.c: Write two short story openings: one starting with While, one using when in the middle.

de.g: Du verbindest Handlungen in der Vergangenheit mit when und while.
p: While steht meist bei der langen Handlung: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When steht meist bei der kurzen Handlung: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Du kannst mit beiden Teilen beginnen; steht das Bindewort vorne, setz ein Komma.
de.q: Vervollständige meinen Satz: While I was waiting for the bus...
de.c: Schreib zwei Geschichtenanfänge: einen mit While vorne, einen mit when in der Mitte.

es.t: When y while en las historias
es.g: Une acciones pasadas con when y while para crear la escena.
p: While suele ir con la acción larga: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When suele ir con la acción corta: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Puedes empezar por cualquier parte; si el conector va primero, pon coma.
es.q: Termina mi frase: While I was waiting for the bus...
es.c: Escribe dos comienzos de historia: uno con While delante y otro con when en medio.

fr.t: When et while dans un récit
fr.g: Relier des actions passées avec when et while pour planter le décor.
p: While va souvent avec l'action longue : While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When va souvent avec l'action courte : I was walking home when it started to rain.
On peut commencer par l'une ou l'autre partie ; mets une virgule si le mot de liaison est devant.
fr.q: Termine ma phrase : While I was waiting for the bus...
fr.c: Écris deux débuts d'histoire : un qui commence par While, un avec when au milieu.

it.g: Colleghi azioni passate con when e while per creare la scena.
p: While va di solito con l'azione lunga: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When va di solito con l'azione breve: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Puoi iniziare da una o dall'altra parte; se il connettivo è all'inizio, metti la virgola.
it.q: Completa la mia frase: While I was waiting for the bus...
it.c: Scrivi due inizi di storia: uno che comincia con While, uno con when nel mezzo.

pt.g: Liga ações passadas com when e while para criar a cena.
p: While costuma ir com a ação longa: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When costuma ir com a ação curta: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Podes começar por qualquer parte; se o conector vier primeiro, põe vírgula.
pt.q: Acaba a minha frase: While I was waiting for the bus...
pt.c: Escreve dois inícios de história: um a começar com While e outro com when no meio.

pt_BR.g: Ligue ações passadas com when e while para montar a cena.
p: While costuma ir com a ação longa: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When costuma ir com a ação curta: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Você pode começar por qualquer parte; se o conectivo vier primeiro, use vírgula.
pt_BR.q: Termine minha frase: While I was waiting for the bus...
pt_BR.c: Escreva dois começos de história: um começando com While e outro com when no meio.

vocab.ex: While I was shopping, I met an old friend.
We were sleeping when the alarm went off.
It started to rain while we were walking.
I was waiting for the bus when I saw him.
While I was reading, suddenly the cat jumped up.
While she was in Rome, she met her best friend.

target.gram: While + long action (past continuous), when + short action (past simple). Comma when the clause comes first.

en.g: Tell a short, funny story using past tenses and story words.
p: Set the scene with the past continuous: It was raining and I was running to the bus.
Move the action with then and suddenly: Suddenly, I slipped and my bag flew open!
Finish with in the end and a reaction: In the end we all laughed.
en.q: Tell me a funny thing that happened to you or a friend, in four or five sentences.
en.c: Write a funny mini story with then, suddenly and in the end, and read it aloud with feeling.

de.g: Du erzählst eine kurze lustige Geschichte mit Vergangenheitsformen und Erzählwörtern.
p: Setz die Szene mit dem past continuous: It was raining and I was running to the bus.
Treib die Handlung mit then und suddenly voran: Suddenly, I slipped and my bag flew open!
Ende mit in the end und einer Reaktion: In the end we all laughed.
de.q: Erzähl mir etwas Lustiges, das dir oder Freunden passiert ist, in vier oder fünf Sätzen.
de.c: Schreib eine lustige Mini-Geschichte mit then, suddenly und in the end und lies sie ausdrucksvoll vor.

es.g: Cuenta una historia corta y divertida con tiempos pasados y palabras de relato.
p: Crea la escena con el past continuous: It was raining and I was running to the bus.
Haz avanzar la acción con then y suddenly: Suddenly, I slipped and my bag flew open!
Termina con in the end y una reacción: In the end we all laughed.
es.q: Cuéntame algo gracioso que te pasó a ti o a un amigo, en cuatro o cinco frases.
es.c: Escribe una mini historia graciosa con then, suddenly e in the end, y léela en voz alta con emoción.

fr.g: Raconter une courte histoire drôle avec les temps du passé et des mots de récit.
p: Plante le décor au past continuous : It was raining and I was running to the bus.
Fais avancer l'action avec then et suddenly : Suddenly, I slipped and my bag flew open!
Termine avec in the end et une réaction : In the end we all laughed.
fr.q: Raconte-moi un truc drôle qui t'est arrivé, à toi ou à un ami, en quatre ou cinq phrases.
fr.c: Écris une petite histoire drôle avec then, suddenly et in the end, et lis-la à voix haute avec entrain.

it.g: Racconti una breve storia divertente con i tempi passati e le parole del racconto.
p: Crea la scena con il past continuous: It was raining and I was running to the bus.
Fai avanzare l'azione con then e suddenly: Suddenly, I slipped and my bag flew open!
Chiudi con in the end e una reazione: In the end we all laughed.
it.q: Raccontami una cosa buffa successa a te o a un amico, in quattro o cinque frasi.
it.c: Scrivi una mini storia buffa con then, suddenly e in the end, e leggila ad alta voce con espressione.

pt.g: Conta uma história curta e engraçada com tempos do passado e palavras de narração.
p: Cria a cena com o past continuous: It was raining and I was running to the bus.
Faz avançar a ação com then e suddenly: Suddenly, I slipped and my bag flew open!
Acaba com in the end e uma reação: In the end we all laughed.
pt.q: Conta-me uma coisa engraçada que te aconteceu a ti ou a um amigo, em quatro ou cinco frases.
pt.c: Escreve uma mini história engraçada com then, suddenly e in the end, e lê-a em voz alta com expressão.

pt_BR.g: Conte uma história curta e engraçada com tempos do passado e palavras de narração.
p: Monte a cena com o past continuous: It was raining and I was running to the bus.
Faça a ação andar com then e suddenly: Suddenly, I slipped and my bag flew open!
Termine com in the end e uma reação: In the end we all laughed.
pt_BR.q: Me conte uma coisa engraçada que aconteceu com você ou um amigo, em quatro ou cinco frases.
pt_BR.c: Escreva uma mini história engraçada com then, suddenly e in the end, e leia em voz alta com emoção.

vocab.ex: Suddenly, a dog ran into the café.
Then the waiter dropped all the cups.
In the end, everyone was laughing.
My dad wore odd socks to the wedding. It was so funny!
We laughed for ten minutes.
One day, I was waiting for a train...

target.gram: Stories: past continuous for the scene, past simple for events, and story words: one day, then, suddenly, in the end.

en.g: Talk about life experiences with have or has plus past participle.
p: Form: have or has plus past participle: I have visited Spain, she has tried sushi.
Regular participles end in -ed. Some are irregular: been, seen, eaten, done.
We don't say when it happened; it is about your life up to now.
en.q: What is something interesting you have done in your life?
en.c: Write five sentences about experiences you have had, using have or has plus a participle.

de.g: Du sprichst mit have oder has und Partizip über Lebenserfahrungen.
p: Form: have oder has plus Partizip: I have visited Spain, she has tried sushi.
Regelmäßige Partizipien enden auf -ed. Manche sind unregelmäßig: been, seen, eaten, done.
Wir sagen nicht, wann es passiert ist; es geht um dein Leben bis jetzt.
de.q: Was ist etwas Interessantes, das du in deinem Leben gemacht hast?
de.c: Schreib fünf Sätze über deine Erfahrungen mit have oder has und einem Partizip.

es.g: Habla de experiencias de vida con have o has más participio.
p: Forma: have o has más participio: I have visited Spain, she has tried sushi.
Los participios regulares acaban en -ed. Algunos son irregulares: been, seen, eaten, done.
No decimos cuándo pasó; se trata de tu vida hasta ahora.
es.q: ¿Qué cosa interesante has hecho en tu vida?
es.c: Escribe cinco frases sobre experiencias que has tenido, con have o has más participio.

fr.g: Parler d'expériences de vie avec have ou has plus participe passé.
p: Forme : have ou has plus participe : I have visited Spain, she has tried sushi.
Les participes réguliers finissent en -ed. Certains sont irréguliers : been, seen, eaten, done.
On ne dit pas quand ; il s'agit de ta vie jusqu'à maintenant.
fr.q: Quelle chose intéressante as-tu faite dans ta vie ?
fr.c: Écris cinq phrases sur des expériences que tu as vécues, avec have ou has plus un participe.

it.g: Parli di esperienze di vita con have o has più participio passato.
p: Forma: have o has più participio: I have visited Spain, she has tried sushi.
I participi regolari finiscono in -ed. Alcuni sono irregolari: been, seen, eaten, done.
Non diciamo quando è successo; si parla della tua vita fino a ora.
it.q: Qual è una cosa interessante che hai fatto nella tua vita?
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi su esperienze che hai fatto, con have o has più un participio.

pt.g: Fala de experiências de vida com have ou has mais particípio.
p: Forma: have ou has mais particípio: I have visited Spain, she has tried sushi.
Os particípios regulares acabam em -ed. Alguns são irregulares: been, seen, eaten, done.
Não dizemos quando aconteceu; fala-se da tua vida até agora.
pt.q: Qual é uma coisa interessante que já fizeste na vida?
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases sobre experiências que já tiveste, com have ou has mais particípio.

pt_BR.g: Fale de experiências de vida com have ou has mais particípio.
p: Forma: have ou has mais particípio: I have visited Spain, she has tried sushi.
Particípios regulares terminam em -ed. Alguns são irregulares: been, seen, eaten, done.
Não dizemos quando aconteceu; o foco é sua vida até agora.
pt_BR.q: Qual é uma coisa interessante que você já fez na vida?
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco frases sobre experiências que você já teve, com have ou has mais particípio.

vocab.ex: I have visited three countries in Europe.
She has tried Indian food many times.
I have been to Paris.
We have seen that film twice.
Have you eaten sushi?
He has done a lot of interesting jobs.

target.gram: Present perfect: have/has + past participle for life experiences without a specific time: I have visited Japan.

en.g: Ask and answer about experiences with ever and never.
p: Ask with ever: Have you ever been to Brazil? Has she ever ridden a horse?
Answer yes with I have, or say I've never... for no experience.
Never is already negative, so don't add not: I've never seen snow.
en.q: Have you ever tried a food that surprised you? Tell me about it.
en.c: Write five Have you ever...? questions and answer each with I have or I've never.

de.g: Du fragst und antwortest mit ever und never über Erfahrungen.
p: Frag mit ever: Have you ever been to Brazil? Has she ever ridden a horse?
Antworte mit Yes, I have oder sag I've never... für keine Erfahrung.
Never ist schon verneint, also kein not dazu: I've never seen snow.
de.q: Hast du je ein Essen probiert, das dich überrascht hat? Erzähl davon.
de.c: Schreib fünf Have you ever...?-Fragen und beantworte jede mit I have oder I've never.

es.g: Pregunta y responde sobre experiencias con ever y never.
p: Pregunta con ever: Have you ever been to Brazil? Has she ever ridden a horse?
Responde sí con Yes, I have o di I've never... si no lo has hecho.
Never ya es negativo, no añadas not: I've never seen snow.
es.q: ¿Has probado alguna vez una comida que te sorprendió? Cuéntamelo.
es.c: Escribe cinco preguntas Have you ever...? y responde cada una con I have o I've never.

fr.g: Poser des questions et répondre sur ses expériences avec ever et never.
p: Demande avec ever : Have you ever been to Brazil? Has she ever ridden a horse?
Réponds oui avec Yes, I have, ou dis I've never... si ce n'est jamais arrivé.
Never est déjà négatif, n'ajoute pas not : I've never seen snow.
fr.q: As-tu déjà goûté un plat qui t'a surpris ? Raconte-moi.
fr.c: Écris cinq questions Have you ever...? et réponds à chacune avec I have ou I've never.

it.g: Chiedi e rispondi sulle esperienze con ever e never.
p: Chiedi con ever: Have you ever been to Brazil? Has she ever ridden a horse?
Rispondi sì con Yes, I have, oppure di' I've never... se non l'hai mai fatto.
Never è già negativo, non aggiungere not: I've never seen snow.
it.q: Hai mai assaggiato un cibo che ti ha sorpreso? Raccontamelo.
it.c: Scrivi cinque domande Have you ever...? e rispondi a ognuna con I have o I've never.

pt.g: Pergunta e responde sobre experiências com ever e never.
p: Pergunta com ever: Have you ever been to Brazil? Has she ever ridden a horse?
Responde sim com Yes, I have ou diz I've never... se nunca fizeste.
Never já é negativo, não juntes not: I've never seen snow.
pt.q: Já provaste alguma comida que te surpreendeu? Conta-me.
pt.c: Escreve cinco perguntas Have you ever...? e responde a cada uma com I have ou I've never.

pt_BR.g: Pergunte e responda sobre experiências com ever e never.
p: Pergunte com ever: Have you ever been to Brazil? Has she ever ridden a horse?
Responda sim com Yes, I have ou diga I've never... se nunca fez.
Never já é negativo, não coloque not: I've never seen snow.
pt_BR.q: Você já provou uma comida que te surpreendeu? Me conte.
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco perguntas Have you ever...? e responda cada uma com I have ou I've never.

vocab.ex: Have you ever been to Brazil?
I've never seen snow.
Have you ever flown? Yes, I have.
Have you ever surfed? No, I haven't.
She has never ridden a horse.
Have you ever tried mango juice?

target.gram: Questions: Have you ever + past participle? Answers: Yes, I have / No, I haven't / I've never + participle (no not).

en.g: Choose between experience with no time and a finished, specific time.
p: Present perfect for experience, no time given: I've been to Rome.
Past simple when you say when: I went there last May. It was beautiful.
A common pattern: ask with the present perfect, then give details in the past simple.
en.q: Have you been to a concert? When did you go and who did you see?
en.c: Write three mini dialogues: a Have you ever...? question, then details in the past simple.

de.g: Du wählst zwischen Erfahrung ohne Zeitangabe und einem fertigen, genauen Zeitpunkt.
p: Present perfect für Erfahrung ohne Zeit: I've been to Rome.
Past simple, wenn du sagst wann: I went there last May. It was beautiful.
Typisch: mit present perfect fragen, dann Details im past simple geben.
de.q: Warst du schon mal auf einem Konzert? Wann warst du dort und wen hast du gesehen?
de.c: Schreib drei Mini-Dialoge: eine Have you ever...?-Frage, dann Details im past simple.

es.g: Elige entre experiencia sin fecha y un momento pasado concreto y terminado.
p: Present perfect para experiencias, sin fecha: I've been to Rome.
Past simple cuando dices cuándo: I went there last May. It was beautiful.
Un patrón típico: pregunta con present perfect y da detalles en past simple.
es.q: ¿Has ido a algún concierto? ¿Cuándo fuiste y a quién viste?
es.c: Escribe tres mini diálogos: una pregunta Have you ever...? y luego detalles en past simple.

fr.g: Choisir entre une expérience sans date et un moment passé précis et terminé.
p: Present perfect pour l'expérience, sans date : I've been to Rome.
Past simple quand on dit quand : I went there last May. It was beautiful.
Schéma courant : on demande au present perfect, puis on détaille au past simple.
fr.q: Es-tu déjà allé à un concert ? Quand y es-tu allé et qui as-tu vu ?
fr.c: Écris trois mini-dialogues : une question Have you ever...?, puis des détails au past simple.

it.g: Scegli tra esperienza senza data e un momento passato preciso e concluso.
p: Present perfect per l'esperienza, senza data: I've been to Rome.
Past simple quando dici quando: I went there last May. It was beautiful.
Schema tipico: chiedi con il present perfect, poi dai dettagli al past simple.
it.q: Sei mai stato a un concerto? Quando ci sei andato e chi hai visto?
it.c: Scrivi tre mini dialoghi: una domanda Have you ever...?, poi dettagli al past simple.

pt.g: Escolhe entre experiência sem data e um momento passado concreto e terminado.
p: Present perfect para experiências, sem data: I've been to Rome.
Past simple quando dizes quando: I went there last May. It was beautiful.
Padrão comum: pergunta com o present perfect e dá pormenores no past simple.
pt.q: Já foste a algum concerto? Quando foste e quem viste?
pt.c: Escreve três mini diálogos: uma pergunta Have you ever...? e depois pormenores no past simple.

pt_BR.g: Escolha entre experiência sem data e um momento passado exato e terminado.
p: Present perfect para experiências, sem data: I've been to Rome.
Past simple quando você diz quando: I went there last May. It was beautiful.
Padrão comum: pergunte com o present perfect e dê detalhes no past simple.
pt_BR.q: Você já foi a algum show? Quando foi e quem você viu?
pt_BR.c: Escreva três mini diálogos: uma pergunta Have you ever...? e depois detalhes no past simple.

vocab.ex: I've been to Rome twice.
I went there last May.
We visited London last May.
She moved to Lisbon in 2019.
When did you go there?
It was a wonderful trip.

target.gram: Present perfect = experience, no time (I've been to Rome). Past simple = finished time (I went in May). Wrong: I've been there last year.

en.g: Share recent news with just, already and yet.
p: Just means a very short time ago: I've just eaten. She's just arrived.
Already means sooner than expected: I've already finished my homework!
Yet is for questions and negatives, at the end: Have you done it yet? Not yet.
en.q: What have you just done before talking to me? And what haven't you done yet today?
en.c: Write a to-do list for today and mark three things done already and two not done yet.

de.g: Du teilst Neuigkeiten mit just, already und yet.
p: Just heißt gerade eben: I've just eaten. She's just arrived.
Already heißt schon, früher als erwartet: I've already finished my homework!
Yet steht in Fragen und Verneinungen am Ende: Have you done it yet? Not yet.
de.q: Was hast du gerade gemacht, bevor du mit mir sprichst? Und was hast du heute noch nicht gemacht?
de.c: Schreib eine To-do-Liste für heute: drei Dinge already erledigt, zwei not yet.

es.g: Cuenta novedades recientes con just, already y yet.
p: Just significa hace muy poco: I've just eaten. She's just arrived.
Already significa ya, antes de lo esperado: I've already finished my homework!
Yet va en preguntas y negativas, al final: Have you done it yet? Not yet.
es.q: ¿Qué acabas de hacer antes de hablar conmigo? ¿Y qué no has hecho todavía hoy?
es.c: Haz una lista de tareas de hoy: marca tres hechas already y dos que aún not yet.

fr.g: Annoncer des nouvelles récentes avec just, already et yet.
p: Just veut dire il y a très peu de temps : I've just eaten. She's just arrived.
Already veut dire déjà, plus tôt que prévu : I've already finished my homework!
Yet s'emploie dans les questions et négations, à la fin : Have you done it yet? Not yet.
fr.q: Qu'est-ce que tu viens de faire avant de me parler ? Et qu'est-ce que tu n'as pas encore fait aujourd'hui ?
fr.c: Écris une liste de tâches du jour : trois déjà faites (already) et deux pas encore (not yet).

it.g: Racconti novità recenti con just, already e yet.
p: Just vuol dire poco fa: I've just eaten. She's just arrived.
Already vuol dire già, prima del previsto: I've already finished my homework!
Yet va nelle domande e nelle negative, alla fine: Have you done it yet? Not yet.
it.q: Cosa hai appena fatto prima di parlare con me? E cosa non hai ancora fatto oggi?
it.c: Scrivi una lista di cose da fare oggi: tre già fatte (already) e due non ancora (not yet).

pt.g: Conta novidades recentes com just, already e yet.
p: Just significa há muito pouco tempo: I've just eaten. She's just arrived.
Already significa já, mais cedo do que se esperava: I've already finished my homework!
Yet usa-se em perguntas e negativas, no fim: Have you done it yet? Not yet.
pt.q: O que acabaste de fazer antes de falar comigo? E o que ainda não fizeste hoje?
pt.c: Faz uma lista de tarefas de hoje: três já feitas (already) e duas ainda não (not yet).

pt_BR.g: Conte novidades recentes com just, already e yet.
p: Just significa agora há pouco: I've just eaten. She's just arrived.
Already significa já, antes do esperado: I've already finished my homework!
Yet aparece em perguntas e negativas, no final: Have you done it yet? Not yet.
pt_BR.q: O que você acabou de fazer antes de falar comigo? E o que ainda não fez hoje?
pt_BR.c: Faça uma lista de tarefas de hoje: três já feitas (already) e duas ainda não (not yet).

vocab.ex: I've just finished my lunch.
She's already booked the tickets.
Have you called him yet?
Have you seen the new film? Not yet.
The train has just arrived.
I haven't packed my bag yet.

target.gram: Present perfect + just (very recent), already (sooner than expected, mid-position), yet (questions/negatives, at the end).

en.g: Say how long something has lasted with for and since.
p: Ask: How long have you lived here? Answer with the present perfect.
For plus a period of time: for three years, for two weeks, for a long time.
Since plus a starting point: since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child.
en.q: How long have you studied English? Answer with for and with since.
en.c: Write five true sentences about your life with for or since: home, work, friends, hobbies.

de.g: Du sagst mit for und since, wie lange etwas schon dauert.
p: Frag: How long have you lived here? Antworte im present perfect.
For plus Zeitraum: for three years, for two weeks, for a long time.
Since plus Startpunkt: since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child.
de.q: Wie lange lernst du schon Englisch? Antworte einmal mit for und einmal mit since.
de.c: Schreib fünf wahre Sätze über dein Leben mit for oder since: Zuhause, Arbeit, Freunde, Hobbys.

es.g: Di cuánto tiempo dura algo con for y since.
p: Pregunta: How long have you lived here? Responde con el present perfect.
For más un periodo: for three years, for two weeks, for a long time.
Since más un punto de inicio: since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child.
es.q: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevas estudiando inglés? Responde con for y con since.
es.c: Escribe cinco frases verdaderas sobre tu vida con for o since: casa, trabajo, amigos, aficiones.

fr.g: Dire depuis combien de temps avec for et since.
p: Demande : How long have you lived here? Réponds au present perfect.
For plus une durée : for three years, for two weeks, for a long time.
Since plus un point de départ : since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child.
fr.q: Depuis combien de temps étudies-tu l'anglais ? Réponds avec for et avec since.
fr.c: Écris cinq phrases vraies sur ta vie avec for ou since : maison, travail, amis, loisirs.

it.g: Dici da quanto tempo dura qualcosa con for e since.
p: Chiedi: How long have you lived here? Rispondi con il present perfect.
For più un periodo: for three years, for two weeks, for a long time.
Since più un punto di partenza: since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child.
it.q: Da quanto tempo studi inglese? Rispondi con for e con since.
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi vere sulla tua vita con for o since: casa, lavoro, amici, hobby.

pt.g: Diz há quanto tempo algo dura com for e since.
p: Pergunta: How long have you lived here? Responde com o present perfect.
For mais um período: for three years, for two weeks, for a long time.
Since mais um ponto de partida: since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child.
pt.q: Há quanto tempo estudas inglês? Responde com for e com since.
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases verdadeiras sobre a tua vida com for ou since: casa, trabalho, amigos, passatempos.

pt_BR.g: Diga há quanto tempo algo dura com for e since.
p: Pergunte: How long have you lived here? Responda com o present perfect.
For mais um período: for three years, for two weeks, for a long time.
Since mais um ponto de partida: since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child.
pt_BR.q: Há quanto tempo você estuda inglês? Responda com for e com since.
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco frases verdadeiras sobre sua vida com for ou since: casa, trabalho, amigos, hobbies.

vocab.ex: How long have you lived here?
I've lived here for three years.
We've known each other for a long time.
She has worked here since 2020.
It has rained since Monday.
I've loved music since I was a child.

target.gram: How long + present perfect? for + period (for two years), since + starting point (since 2020, since Monday).

en.g: Talk about places you've visited and things you've tried.
p: Open with the present perfect: I've been to Greece. I've tried octopus.
Give details in the past simple: I went there two years ago and stayed by the sea.
Add opinions: It was amazing, the food was delicious, I'd love to go back.
en.q: What's the most interesting place you've been to? What did you do there?
en.c: Write a short travel story: one place, when you went, what you did and how it was.

de.g: Du sprichst über Orte, die du besucht, und Dinge, die du probiert hast.
p: Beginne mit dem present perfect: I've been to Greece. I've tried octopus.
Details im past simple: I went there two years ago and stayed by the sea.
Füg Meinungen hinzu: It was amazing, the food was delicious, I'd love to go back.
de.q: Was ist der interessanteste Ort, an dem du warst? Was hast du dort gemacht?
de.c: Schreib eine kurze Reisegeschichte: ein Ort, wann, was du gemacht hast und wie es war.

es.g: Habla de lugares que has visitado y cosas que has probado.
p: Empieza con el present perfect: I've been to Greece. I've tried octopus.
Da detalles en past simple: I went there two years ago and stayed by the sea.
Añade opiniones: It was amazing, the food was delicious, I'd love to go back.
es.q: ¿Cuál es el lugar más interesante en el que has estado? ¿Qué hiciste allí?
es.c: Escribe un breve relato de viaje: un lugar, cuándo fuiste, qué hiciste y qué tal fue.

fr.g: Parler des lieux visités et des choses que tu as essayées.
p: Commence au present perfect : I've been to Greece. I've tried octopus.
Donne les détails au past simple : I went there two years ago and stayed by the sea.
Ajoute ton avis : It was amazing, the food was delicious, I'd love to go back.
fr.q: Quel est l'endroit le plus intéressant où tu es allé ? Qu'as-tu fait là-bas ?
fr.c: Écris un court récit de voyage : un lieu, quand, ce que tu as fait et comment c'était.

it.g: Parli dei posti che hai visitato e delle cose che hai provato.
p: Comincia con il present perfect: I've been to Greece. I've tried octopus.
Dai i dettagli al past simple: I went there two years ago and stayed by the sea.
Aggiungi opinioni: It was amazing, the food was delicious, I'd love to go back.
it.q: Qual è il posto più interessante in cui sei stato? Cosa hai fatto lì?
it.c: Scrivi un breve racconto di viaggio: un posto, quando, cosa hai fatto e com'è stato.

pt.g: Fala de sítios que visitaste e coisas que experimentaste.
p: Começa com o present perfect: I've been to Greece. I've tried octopus.
Dá pormenores no past simple: I went there two years ago and stayed by the sea.
Junta opiniões: It was amazing, the food was delicious, I'd love to go back.
pt.q: Qual é o sítio mais interessante onde já estiveste? O que fizeste lá?
pt.c: Escreve uma pequena história de viagem: um sítio, quando foste, o que fizeste e como foi.

pt_BR.g: Fale de lugares que você visitou e coisas que experimentou.
p: Comece com o present perfect: I've been to Greece. I've tried octopus.
Dê detalhes no past simple: I went there two years ago and stayed by the sea.
Acrescente opiniões: It was amazing, the food was delicious, I'd love to go back.
pt_BR.q: Qual é o lugar mais interessante onde você já esteve? O que fez lá?
pt_BR.c: Escreva uma pequena história de viagem: um lugar, quando foi, o que fez e como foi.

vocab.ex: I've been to Greece and Turkey.
I've tried octopus, and I loved it!
We stayed in a small hotel by the sea.
The local food was delicious.
It was amazing. I'd love to go back.
It was my first trip abroad.

target.gram: Travel talk: present perfect to introduce (I've been to...), past simple for details (I went in June, it was great).
